acceptanceCriteria: Diagnostics for evidence files are produced without opening documents that are not already open, or the number opened is bounded, with a test.
body: Found by the 2026-09-27 adapter audit for rc.2. extensions/vscode/src/presentation.ts:177 calls vscode.workspace.openTextDocument for each evidence URI to map line ranges, which loads every cited file into the extension host and fires onDidOpenTextDocument for other extensions. Large context results cost memory and trigger language servers.
